readiness.required: FINAL false→OBSERVATION_ONLY بدون actuation؛ FINAL معتبر→EXECUTED فقط با تأیید segment و لغو latch؛ خطا→FAILED/HOLD
readiness.actual: FAILED route HOLD carries HOLD_UNVERIFIED, cancel outcome/errors and unknown actuation after attempted submission; zero throttle/ACK never certifies physical safety

readiness.required: بارگذاری prior باید از صلاحیت تصمیم جاری جدا بماند
readiness.actual: commission_online_control ممکن است READY برای binding prior برگرداند؛ actuation_executed=false و معنی read-only؛ تغییر وابستگی prior در R2 است

gaps.required: لغو هدف‌دار با توقف latch و تایید GUI؛ تداوم و lifecycle جدا پذیرفته شوند
gaps.actual: R6.01/R6.02: targeted cancel and operation-bound retry/completion proof; repeat/lost-ACK/newer-command acceptance recorded. Segment/HOLD/lifecycle remain R6.03-R6.05.
R5.04-R5.06: versioned real status and bounded IMU history; correlation uses verified plant interval, invalid observations/replay rejected at consumption; no flight release

gaps.required: مرز demo و مسیر تولیدی در قرارداد روشن باشد
gaps.actual: run_demo_sequence دستورهای phase و safety literals خود را دارد؛ نتیجهٔ آن proof تصمیم L2-L7 و GNSS-denied نیست

invariants: TDOC مالک orchestration است؛ Layer5 تنها مرجع تصمیم اجرایی معتبر است و GUI تنها مالک MAVLink این مسیر است.
Offline فقط prior راهنماست؛ نیاز به نمونهٔ آفلاین نظیر به نظیر برای هر تصمیم Online تعریف نمی‌شود. state تازهٔ L2/L3 مبنا و تصمیم از حلقهٔ ۲ تا ۷ است.
integrity، نسخه، hash، مدل، forcing و freshness لازم‌اند؛ prior ناسازگار reuse نمی‌شود. اعتبار هویت prior معادل FINAL یا صلاحیت پرواز نیست.
CALL_SHAPE_COMPATIBLE فقط تطبیق signature است؛ readiness بسته، heartbeat، ACK intake و demo اثبات execution یا حلقهٔ تولیدی نیستند.
فرمان pilot-domain با actuator-domain متفاوت است. direct PWM، FINAL ساختگی، تزریق truth و فرمان خارج از تصمیم Layer5 مجاز نیست.
هیچ نمونهٔ گمشده، زمان، quaternion، health یا observation با مقدار پیش‌فرض یا truth پر نمی‌شود؛ نبود داده صریح می‌ماند.
در این ثبت قرارداد reset، دانلود، rebuild، آموزش، ساخت Client، شروع stack و ارسال فرمان اجرا نمی‌شود.
امضا و producer موجود از AST ثبت می‌شود؛ الزامات semantic از خواندن سورس آمده‌اند و به‌عنوان رفتار زندهٔ تأییدشده گزارش نمی‌شوند.

retired_production_calls_R3_05.reason: fixture-related automatic model restart removed; public Layer6 API remains available
fixture-related automatic model restart removed; public Layer6 API remains available

observation_acceptance_R5_06.scope: local receipt/progression at actual consumption; no absolute source latency or flight authority
observation_acceptance_R5_06.health: SYS_STATUS/EKF_STATUS_REPORT metadata must also be valid at estimator-readiness consumption
observation_acceptance_R5_06.freshness: per-channel MAX_AGE cap; re-evaluate reported age plus local elapsed time; contradictory, missing, future, stale or cross-domain evidence rejected
observation_acceptance_R5_06.replay: arrival order, actual six-axis samples, matching source/session/domain and integration grant required; no sort/dedup, no timestamp repair, no endpoint overwrite
observation_acceptance_R5_06.history_age: old buffered records are historical observations; current-state freshness and integration coverage are separate checks
observation_acceptance_R5_06.environment: environment verification remains mandatory; no cache/timeout relaxation; status observations projected after heavy environment validation

targeted_cancel_R6_01.success: ok=true, cancelled=true, latch_cancelled=true, gui_cancelled=true plus matching GUI ACK and replay fence
targeted_cancel_R6_01.None: resolve current service generation; never broadcast GUI release; cancelled=false if no matching latch
targeted_cancel_R6_01.replay: control-session peer/sequence + revoked instance fence; bounded non-evicting storage, full session closed
targeted_cancel_R6_01.post_cancel_output: matched/current-or-last generation inhibits MANUAL_CONTROL fallback until a new accepted state

cancel_operations_R6_02.identity: client session + monotonic operation sequence + nonce + payload fingerprint + peer
cancel_operations_R6_02.binding: target resolved once on first service handling; duplicate operation never resolves current target again
cancel_operations_R6_02.retry: Client retains the identical operation after timeout/unconfirmed ACK, including original reason even if retry reason changes; known new generation or completed prior call defines a new operation
cancel_operations_R6_02.completion_replay: only the original actual successful GUI proof may be replayed, explicitly labelled original_operation_completed; never a new observation of current latch
cancel_operations_R6_02.pending_with_newer_command: cancelled=false and unconfirmed; no old GUI wait/clear can interfere with newer service latch
cancel_operations_R6_02.bounded_history: evicted/unseen older operations rejected by non-evicting client watermarks; no retarget
cancel_operations_R6_02.lifecycle_scope: same service/GUI process lifetime; persistent restart guarantees remain R6.05

first_move_segment_R6_03.scope: continuous command latch only; physical HOLD remains R6.04
first_move_segment_R6_03.proof: two actual ordered-stream TIMESYNC nonce barriers and SCALED_IMU clock witnesses; duration upper <= authorized cap
first_move_segment_R6_03.deadline: admission/confirmation only; never extends maximum plant duration
first_move_segment_R6_03.post_observation: fresh frozen closure snapshot; original R5.06 consumption checks retained
first_move_segment_R6_03.short_execution: conservative bounded prefix; no full 0.1s claim or exact midpoint
first_move_segment_R6_03.full_status: blocked while segment active to avoid heavy environment work in the close path

timeout_HOLD_R6_04.GUI_expiry: TTL and packet admission deadline close the exact generation, inhibit inherited output and revoke refresh/action replay before processing arriving packets
timeout_HOLD_R6_04.service_expiry: targeted cancel_bound retains instance/retry state; never broadcast release
timeout_HOLD_R6_04.release: identity/peer bound to last actually sent state; unscoped release cannot clear another owner
timeout_HOLD_R6_04.HOLD: HOLD_UNVERIFIED regardless of zero throttle or cancel success; no autonomous ARM/mode/zero/PWM fallback
timeout_HOLD_R6_04.failed_submission: execution_confirmation UNCONFIRMED; actuation_executed unknown when submission attempted
timeout_HOLD_R6_04.physical_acceptance_scope: sampled disarmed fourfoot ground quiescence, not airborne HOLD; FCU RC retention observed separately
timeout_HOLD_R6_04.airborne: no flight release from transport or ground acceptance; current provider and Layer5 authority remain required

native_lifecycle_R6_05.startup: three real terminal workers, real ArduPilot/JSBSim, MAVProxy, bound Environment Adapter, intake and Qt GUI
native_lifecycle_R6_05.ownership: unique same-UID session tag + PID birth identity, no global process-name cleanup
native_lifecycle_R6_05.reuse: same exact live binding; no overwrite of active knowledge/forcing identity
native_lifecycle_R6_05.stop: owned process cleanup independent of cancellation outcome; failed cleanup retains owner handle
native_lifecycle_R6_05.GUI: managed session inhibits manual startup/close writes and manual ARM/mode; actual control only from accepted virtual state
native_lifecycle_R6_05.wind: batched SET echo phase followed by independent GET phase; all six values/source/time checks retained; no freshness or timeout relaxation
native_lifecycle_R6_05.remaining: flight and R604 physical rate finding not certified by transport readiness
native_lifecycle_R6_05.boot: managed public intake and GUI actuation messages bind exact native boot UUID; old/missing boot rejected before admission; restart clears client operation caches
native_lifecycle_R6_05.status_validation: per-request full validation in QThread, no result cache; fresh GUI telemetry projection on delivery and TDOC revalidation retained; TTL unchanged

retired_production_calls.purpose: status-only ARM bootstrap retired; external client utility remains available; no production TDOC caller
retired_production_calls.time_tx: tau_apply و deadline در wall epoch؛ ttl_s ثانیه؛ tx صریح از TDOC
retired_production_calls.replacement: current verified Layer5 D_exec -> Layer6OnlineAdapter.invoke -> Layer6Client.submit
